image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a metallic, rectangular object held by human fingers against a dark blue background. The object resembles a vintage or industrial-style lighter with a ribbed metal casing and an open top. A small, soft-focus orange flame is visible emerging from the top right area of the object. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the metallic texture and the thumb holding the device.

artifact_observations.location: Top right corner of lighter body
artifact_observations.reasoning: The geometry where the flame emerges lacks clear structural definition. The metal casing seems to blend into the background or the flame without a distinct nozzle or chimney structure, appearing somewhat amorphous.

The flame is extremely smooth and lacks the complex turbulent structure of a real flame, resembling a painted blob or Gaussian blur more than a combustion process. This is common in AI generations but technically an artifact of physical realism.
